title: [7.0] WSL machines: stop supporting legacy systemd
body:
### Feature request description

WSL provides their systemd native support and [we are using it for new machines](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/pull/29837). Pre-existing machines are still using a namespaced systemd and the code to start/stop/getstate of a machine is complicated because it needs to handle both cases.

### Suggest potential solution

Remove the start/stop/getstate source code that handles legacy machines in Podman v7.

### Have you considered any alternatives?

In 6.x, add a warning for users that start a legacy machine.

Also automatic migration from legacy to native systemd could be considered in a 6.x release. Note that in this case it would be simpler to migrate the machine at `machine stop` to avoid complicating the start flow and to avoid a restart.
